incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC-1234567 triggered for service=encoder-service env=prod — 5xx spike on /v1/embeddings.encode – alerting oncall

deepti (oncall): acked. I see the canary rollout finished ~2m ago. pinging backend + sre.

jonah (backend): seeing lots of 502/503s from encoder pods. stack shows tokenizer hitting out-of-range on some sequences. reproducing locally now with same token stream.

marc (eng-sre): confirm: was traffic shifted to new encoder:v3.2.1 canary? deploy-bot, status?

deploy-bot: canary deployed: encoder:v3.2.1 at 10% traffic (weight=0.1). rollout completed at 1752467945. No automated rollback configured.

jonah (backend): minimal reproducer: content contains long repeated "<PAD>" sequences — encoder v3.2.1 path triggers exception in tokenizer.decode(). log snippet:

```
E 10:13:02 encoder[pid=7]: TokenizerError: index out of range at decode.py:142
E trace: /srv/encoder/tokenizer.py line 142
E request_id=abc-123 user=acct-555 input_len=4096
```

maya (support): we have 3 customer reports: embeddings failures on ingest jobs. two are high-priority onboarding customers — tagging support runbook. sending temporary updates to their CSMs.

deepti (oncall): mitigation options: 1) divert canary traffic back to v3.2.0 (immediate), 2) throttle embeddings route to reduce error amplification, 3) scale up old pods. Johnah/marc which is fastest?

jonah (backend): fastest is to change traffic routing -> set canary weight=0.0. k8s traffic config is through gateway flagset. I can flip to route 100% to encoder:v3.2.0 in ~30s.

marc (eng-sre): I'll prep a rollback patch in case. stepping through PD escalation policy. tagging on-call handoff in 30m.

deepti (oncall): go for traffic divert. jonah please run the command and post result. also post the kubectl rollout status just to confirm.

jonah (backend): running: `kubectl set image deployment/encoder encoder=registry.redwood/encoder:v3.2.0 --namespace=prod` (note: service uses traffic-split). Actually switching traffic split now:
```
curl -X POST https://gateway/api/traffic-split -d '{"service":"encoder","weights":{"v3.2.1":0.0,"v3.2.0":1.0}}'
```

jonah (backend): response 200. weights now v3.2.1=0.0 v3.2.0=1.0.

marc (eng-sre): monitoring. p50/p95 errors dropping in metrics. I see request success rate climb back to baseline over last 40s.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-1234567 status changed: acknowledged by deepti (oncall) — escalation paused.

maya (support): notified affected customers with temporary workaround and ETA for full fix. CSMs looped in.

deepti (oncall): good. action items: jonah to prepare a hotfix branch with tokenizer guard; marc to run a canary with extra fuzz tests; luis to prepare customer postmortem note; i'll start a incident doc and schedule follow-up.

luis (product): capturing impact: 3 customers affected, ingest pipelines delayed ~10-25m, no data loss reported. prioritizing hotfix based on customer severity.

jonah (backend): creating branch: hotfix/tokenizer-bounds-check. quick patch ready, unit + integ tests running. will request canary with 1% and run targeted fuzz suite.

marc (eng-sre): please don't rollout new canary to >1% until we verify fuzz tests. also adding automatic rollback threshold for errors>2% sustained for 5m.

oncall-handoff-bot: deepti scheduled handoff to marc at 1752470000 (30m) — reminder set.

deepti (oncall): handing off timeline + notes: diverted traffic to v3.2.0, PD incident acknowledged, customers notified. Marc — you'll own until hotfix verifies. I'll be available on call for the handoff.

marc (eng-sre): taking over. I'll coordinate hotfix verification and then safe rollout plan (gradual 1->5->20% with guardrails). any objections?

jonah (backend): agree. I'll open PR and link tests. ETA for canary run ~12m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-1234567 status changed: resolved (auto) — no further alerts after traffic divert.

maya (support): marking support tickets with incident ref INC-1234567 and adding note: "temporary traffic diversion applied; hotfix in progress".

luis (product): prepping short customer-facing note to go out after hotfix verification.

marc (eng-sre): follow-up checklist created: root cause analysis, fuzz-suite expanded, deploy guard configured. scheduling postmortem doc with timeline.

deepti (oncall): thanks team. closing this thread for active paging, will reopen if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
